d: A string searching algorithm that uses hashing to find any one of a set of pattern strings in a text.
c: Find All Anagrams (can use sliding window hash)

p: Rabin-Karp is a string searching algorithm that uses a Rolling Hash. Instead of comparing strings character by character O(N*M), it compares their hashes O(1). If hashes match, it does a deep check to avoid collisions.
1. Compute hash of the pattern and first window of text.
2. Slide window: subtract value of outgoing char, multiply by base, add value of incoming char.
3. Compare window hash with pattern hash. If equal, verify.

def rabin_karp(text, pattern):
  # Simplified logic
  p_hash = hash(pattern)
  t_hash = hash(text[:len(pattern)])
  for i in range(len(text) - len(pattern) + 1):
    if p_hash == t_hash and text[i:i+len(pattern)] == pattern:
      return i
    # Roll the hash (O(1) operation mathematically)
    t_hash = roll_hash(t_hash, text[i], text[i+len(pattern)])
  return -1
Time: O(N+M) average, O(N*M) worst case (collisions). Space: O(1).

Text:   A B C D E     Pattern: C D E
Hash(ABC) = H1
Hash(BCD) = (H1 - A*k) * p + D = H2
Hash(CDE) = (H2 - B*k) * p + E = H3 == Hash(Pattern)!
